open_points.subject: K-02 purity boundary vs A03 sandbox filesystem access
open_points.text: K-02: "A function node runs ... no network, no filesystem beyond its input"; A03 rule 1: "one private exchange directory ..." and rule 4 allows opening paths inside "the exchange directory and the read-only runtime."
open_points.question: Are function implementations allowed to perform filesystem I/O in the exchange directory, or must any user-level file open be treated as a sandbox violation to keep "no filesystem beyond its input" literal?
options: Allow read/write inside the exchange directory (ephemeral scratch is permitted).
Forbid all function filesystem I/O (except runtime internals), treating user opens as violations.
open_points.default_guess: Allow exchange-directory I/O, because A03 specifies and enforces it explicitly.

open_points.subject: A04 trial-case shape requirements
open_points.text: A04 rule 1: "added only when its input values fit the contract version's input ports, its expected outputs, when present, fit the output ports"
open_points.question: Must authored trial-case inputs and expected_outputs match the contract port sets exactly (no missing or extra ports), or is partial expected output (or extra keys) allowed?
options: Require exact port-set match for inputs and, when present, for expected_outputs.
Require exact inputs, but allow expected_outputs to be a subset.
Allow extra keys and ignore unmatched ones.
open_points.default_guess: Require exact match; otherwise pass/fail semantics become implementation-dependent.

open_points.subject: A14 startup recovery failure handling
open_points.text: A14 rule 5: "the kernel turns every in_flight EffectAttempt into unknown ... and then advances ... every run left running"
open_points.question: If recovery of one run fails partway (e.g., store call failure or invocation failure outside normal node outcomes), does startup stop (kernel refuses to open surface) or continue recovering remaining runs and open surface anyway?
options: Fail startup on first unrecoverable recovery error.
Continue best-effort recovery per run, then open surface with partial recovery done.
open_points.default_guess: Fail startup, to avoid exposing a partially recovered state with unknown consistency.
